title: Asymptotic Rounding Laws for Optimal Thresholds in Secretary Problems
summary: We study second-order asymptotics for optimal thresholds in secretary-type problems. Under a unimodality assumption and a local affine expansion of the discrete payoff increments, we establish a general principle showing that sufficiently accurate rational approximations to the leading threshold proportion yield exact optimal integer thresholds. Continued-fraction convergents provide an immediate application. We also derive an asymptotic rounding law and apply the results to several variants of the secretary problem with fixed and random horizons.
